items.title: Details Emerge About the Sudden Death of ESPN Legend Tom Jackson at 75
items.summary:
New details have emerged about the death of ESPN broadcaster and former NFL player Tom Jackson after the sudden loss, which friends have described as a “shock.” 

Jackson was pronounced dead at 4:15 p.m. on Friday, November 20, at Christ Hospital in Cincinnati, the Hamilton County Coroner’s Office confirmed to Us on Monday, November 23. He was 75.  

An autopsy was performed on Monday, and results are still pending. Jackson’s cause of death remains undetermined.  

Jackson’s former ESPN colleague Chris Berman said he had spoken “at length” with Jackson on November 17, three days before his death.  

Missing Coach Travis Turner's Wife Addresses His Disappearance 1-Year Later 

“All of us are stunned,” Berman said in a statement released by ESPN on Sunday, November 22. “I’m stunned, we’re stunned and you’re stunned. … I was fortunate to work side by side with Tom for 30 years, primarily on NFL Primetime and Sunday NFL Countdown . It was a labor of love for our whole team, both in front of the camera and behind it. We always hoped our viewers enjoyed the shows as much as we did bringing it to them every week.” 

Berman added, “Tom was so much more than an accomplished NFL analyst. There was nobody kinder, more thoughtful, more loyal or more engaging than him. And when it came to laughter, Tom’s was frequent and unmistakable. He is easily summed up by this classic old song: ‘He’s got sunshine on a cloudy day.’” 

Jackson’s former Denver Broncos teammate Bob Swenson called his death “unexpected.” 

“I talked to him every week, sometimes every day,” Swenson, 73, told the Denver…
items.t: Details Emerge About the Sudden Death of ESPN Legend Tom Jackson at 75

items.title: Tom Brady Admits He’s Made 'A Lot of Mistakes' as a Father
items.summary:
Tom Brady got brutally honest about where he may have slipped up as a father.

During the Sunday, November 22, episode of the “High Performance” podcast, Brady, 49, acknowledged that he could be a “better” dad to his three kids. (The retired NFL quarterback shares son Jack, 19, with ex Bridget Moynahan , as well as son Benjamin, 16, and daughter Vivian, 13, with ex-wife Gisele Bündchen .)

“The important thing for me in my personal life is to go where my kids are at too,” he explained. “I think it’s been a really important lesson for me over the years to go to my kids and say, ‘What’s really important to you, what’s driving you, or what are you scared of, or how can I pay attention to the things that you value?’”

Brady broke down his approach to connecting with his kids, adding, “So part of that is just being really open and present and also trying to be really relatable to the younger [generation], which I was very fortunate to learn over the course of my playing career.”

Tom Brady’s Most Honest Quotes About Fatherhood 

When host Jake Humphrey recalled listening to Brady’s “Parenting Tips” podcast,the retired athlete replied, “Well, I’ve made a lot of mistakes.”

“So, a lot like [being a] quarterback. I threw a lot of interceptions. And [at] every one I’ve tried to learn from,” he noted. “And I’d hope I’m a better parent today than I was when I first started having kids. And hopefully I’m a better parent 10 years from now.”

items.title: Prince William and Kate Middleton's Sandringham Estate Home Broken Into
items.summary:
Prince William and Princess Kate Middleton ‘s home at the royal family’s Sandringham estate has been broken into.

Us understands the royal couple were not at the residence when the incident occurred on Monday, November 23.

The Sun was first to report the security breach at Anmer Hall in Norfolk, England, revealing authorities launched an investigation. Norfolk Police reportedly arrested two men on suspicion of burglary and trespass.

“Police were called shortly before 6pm last night following a report of suspicious activity at Anmer Hall on the Sandringham Estate,” officers told The Sun. “Officers attended the scene and deployed specialist resources, including police dogs, drones, and the National Police Air Service helicopter, to assist with searches in the area.”

The two suspects are still in police custody, per authorities.

Royal Family Home Scandals: From Fires to Break-Ins 

William and Kate, both 44, were given their Sandringham residence by the late Queen Elizabeth II in 2011 to celebrate their wedding. The couple and their children — Prince George , 13, Princess Charlotte , 11, and Prince Louis , 8 — now spend most of their time in Windsor.

“The kids can play outside and be normal there,” a source told Us earlier this year about the family’s Forest Lodge home.

items.title: Rob Lowe Makes Rare Comment on His Infamous Sex Tape Scandal in Netflix Doc
items.summary:
Nothing was off-limits in Rob Lowe ‘s documentary — not even his infamous sex tape scandal.

During Rob Lowe: The Outsider , which was released on Tuesday, November 24, the actor, 62, recalled when he first learned that the video was leaked, saying, “We go to Cannes to announce [my 1990 movie Bad Influence], and it was there I was told that I was leading the news.”

Lowe was campaigning for Michael Dukakis in the 1988 presidential election when he filmed a sex tape with 22-year-old Tara Seburt and her 16-year-old friend Lena Jan Parsons . At the time, Georgia’s age of consent laws permitted certain sexual activity with someone who was 16. However, federal law set 18 as the minimum age for appearing in sexually explicit recordings.

The St. Elmo’s Fire star, for his part, maintained that he thought Parsons was 21 because they met at a nightclub before the encounter.

Rob Lowe's Most Candid Quotes About His Infamous Sex Tape Scandal 

“I was advised by Hollywood’s finest to not defend myself, so I didn’t. Because they’re the experts,” Lowe said in his Netflix doc. “I’m not trying to do revisionist history but we were in an over-21 bar. I’m a known film actor and I had to show my ID to get in. I had no idea that one of the girls was underage.”

The footage went on to become one of the first-ever commercially released celebrity sex tapes. Lowe, meanwhile, settled a lawsuit with Parsons’ family out of court and was not charged with a crime. His career took a hit, however, when he had to step out of the public eye amid the controversy.

items.title: Boxer Tyson Fury Announces Schizophrenia Diagnosis in New Netflix Doc
items.summary:
Boxer Tyson Fury is getting candid about his mental health.

In a new feature-length documentary, Tyson Fury , the multi-time champion opened up about being diagnosed with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder in 2015, shortly after his world heavyweight championship victory over Wladimir Klitschko .

According to Deadline , which previewed the documentary ahead of its Friday, November 27, release via Netflix, Fury, 38, said, “Words can’t explain the darkness I was in.”

“I came from the living version of the pits of hellfire. And I 100% thought at times I’d end up in a padded room with the door locked, and that scared me so much,” he went on.

Meet Boxer Tyson Fury’s Family: His Wife, 7 Kids, Famous Brother and More 

“I was waking up in the night like this … the anxiety was crippling me. I just could not overcome it,” Fury added. “Completely gone, and that’s when I went and saw the psychiatrist down in London. She asked me like a gazillion questions, and I ticked all the boxes, whatever was going on. Depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder.”

The documentary also features interviews with Fury’s father, John Fury , and his wife, Paris Fury .

“I can tell you this, when I look back, it’s always been there,” John said in the doc. “Me being who I am and no understanding of anything, I didn’t want to see a depressed kid — and if I did see it, I paid no mind to it. But I understand now. It’s an illness, a terrible illness. I suffer with it myself.”

In the doc, Fury recalled how he decided to get help and turn his life around after a sobering moment over Halloween 2017.
